purpose: Audit-faithful implementation-fidelity successor to btc-eth-relative-value-rotation-v1, not strategy improvement, parameter search, or rehabilitation of the contaminated Phase 1 headline return.
objective: Test the unchanged fixed BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT relative-strength rotation hypothesis only after the v1 execution, synchronization, terminal-fill, and DSR implementation defects are mechanically corrected and independently approved.

phase_1_preservation.prior_evidence_treatment: The reported +41.53% result and every v1 metric remain contaminated diagnostic prior evidence. They count toward multiplicity, may prioritize this authorized successor, and may not select, change, or justify any v2 signal, parameter, threshold, cost, trial, gate, fold, clock, seed, or performance claim.
phase_1_preservation.immutability: No Phase 1 artifact, result, audit, ledger entry, commit, publication, or terminal verdict is rewritten, deleted, softened, relabeled, or promoted by this successor.

effective_contract_resolution.base: The exact frozen v1 preregistration is inherited. Its metadata fields schema_version, status, experiment_id, timestamps, source_commit, preregistration_sha256, direction_review, model_routing, and Phase 1 budget are replaced by this Phase 2 wrapper. Every substantive clause remains byte-semantically unchanged unless explicitly named in amendments below.

amendment_manifest.value: For synchronized completed signal session s and the named trial, I_s is the maximum event timestamp and causal availability timestamp over every required close, return, volatility input, and other lookback observation for both BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT. Any missing, malformed, nonfinite, incomplete, or unavailable required observation makes the decision ineligible or triggers the inherited causal quarantine rule; no partial information set is allowed.

C_s is the single earliest exact minute-open timestamp strictly greater than I_s at which retained strict-boundary-prefix rows exist for both BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT at the identical timestamp. The exact two retained row identities form one atomic vector. Per-asset selection, unequal timestamps, forward fill, synthetic rows, one-asset vectors, and independent forward scans are prohibited.

In an independent base run, compute decision s exactly once after signal session s is complete using session-s information and actual state immediately after C_(s-1), and bind it to C_s. At C_s first accrue the C_(s-1)-to-C_s interval under the prior actual state, then execute decision s exactly once, apply unchanged turnover/cost accounting, and update actual state. No later decision may supersede it.

In an independent delayed run, at C_s first accrue the prior interval, then execute the immutable decision s-1 due at C_s, apply unchanged turnover/cost accounting, and update actual state. Using completed session-s information and that resulting actual state, compute decision s exactly once and queue it only for C_(s+1). The first eligible session queues without filling. No intervening decision supersedes a pending target. Base and delayed runs have independent states and may produce different decisions; immutability applies within each run only.

From the already constructed strict-prefix canonical sequence, select its actual last C_s strictly before the half-open evaluation end. In base mode replace decision s with cash; in delayed mode replace the due decision s-1 with cash. Cancel every other pending target, accrue and cost the terminal transition unchanged, compute no new decision at or after that vector, and end in exact cash with no pending state. No assumed wall-clock timestamp, synthetic identity, or row at/after the boundary may substitute.

At every development, validation, audit, freeze, and other pre-HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED entry point, allow only the exact 36 verified development entries and reject any year=2026 path token before path resolution, stat, footer, schema, or value access. The only exception is the separately latched post-approval holdout entry point defined by the amended holdout clauses; no general discovery is permitted.

Before invoking any session, gap, cutoff, canonical-vector, state, regime, or accounting logic, build an immutable boundary-specific index using only retained development rows strictly before the fold end. Slice every input to that strict prefix. No post-end row, gap, availability event, price, session, or vector can invalidate or alter the fold.

Use the exact append-only N from multiplicity_registry for the current stage: 56 for first completed development, 63 after one completed invalidated development run, 70 after two; post-approval holdout adds seven slots and uses 63, 70, or 77 respectively.

Use every and only finite observed nonannualized daily Sharpe bound by the ordered slot-level multiplicity registry. For first completed v2 development this is 28 prior observed slots plus seven current trial slots. The 21 named no-return slots remain absent and unimputed.

sigma_SR*((1-Euler_gamma)*Phi_inverse(1-1/N)+Euler_gamma*Phi_inverse(1-1/(N*e))), where sigma_SR is sample standard deviation ddof=1 over every and only finite observed registry Sharpe and N is the current append-only slot count.

Let observed be the current primary nonannualized daily Sharpe on the exact seven-current-trial common causal panel. Compute exact lag-1-through-28 autocorrelations, VIF, T_eff, bias-false skew, and nonexcess kurtosis as specified in statistical_phase_2_amendments. Probability is Phi((observed-SR0)*sqrt(T_eff-1)/sqrt(1-skew*observed+((nonexcess_kurtosis-1)/4)*observed^2)).
Use the exact preregistered 28-lag Bartlett-weighted VIF and T_eff; do not treat time-series observations as independent.

The primitive v1 formula accepts T=3 when every v1 input and denominator is defined and rejects only T<3. The formal Phase 2 gate additionally returns probability zero for wrong slot identity/order/hash/count, missing current trial, invented value, nonfinite raw return or observed Sharpe, zero sigma_SR, T<30, missing/nonfinite lag, nonpositive centered denominator, invalid VIF, T_eff<30, nonpositive probability denominator, or any other nonfinite derived value.
For finite raw returns, zero sample standard deviation maps to negative infinity when mean<=0 and positive infinity when mean>0. These intentional infinities are valid deterministic rank values.

Fewer than eight common observations, an empty block, nonfinite raw return, NaN derived Sharpe, undefined declared-order tie resolution, undefined average rank, nonfinite logit, or split count other than 70 yields PBO one. Intentional plus/minus infinity arising only from the declared finite zero-volatility rule remains rankable.

The reused data contract remains exact PASS; every development gate, implementation-fidelity review, development-methodology audit, and pre-holdout robustness audit passes; exact code/configuration/data-manifest/environment/traces are cleanly committed and frozen; and a separate live read-only Sol/xhigh holdout-open audit returns HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED. Before that token no 2026 path may be resolved.

Before resolving a holdout filesystem path, commit a record binding source commit, frozen preregistration hash, data-contract hash, the exact ordered 12 holdout relative paths/byte counts/SHA-256 values derived from the frozen contract without filesystem access, evaluator/oracle/environment hashes, seeds, every prior audit artifact hash, and HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED. The separately latched holdout entry point accepts only those 12 entries and permits no directory discovery.

After the access-record commit and only through the separately latched holdout entry point, resolving the first exact allowlisted path is permitted; first footer/schema/value access arms the one-shot latch. Exactly one deterministic invocation may access the 12 allowlisted partitions. Seven holdout trial slots are appended whether the invocation completes or partially fails; no rerun is permitted.

Any read, schema, signal, execution, quarantine, accounting, statistic, evaluator, serialization, or audit-input error after the latch is armed terminates HOLDOUT_EVALUATION_FAILURE. Preserve all seven named holdout slots, include only durably serialized finite Sharpes in DSR dispersion, leave every missing value unimputed, promote no partial result, and permit no repair, rerun, reopen, or replacement.

effective_contract_resolution.resolution_algorithm: Parse the exact v1 JSON; verify its byte hash, self-excluding canonical hash, and all 14 root-clause hashes; remove only the declared v1 metadata fields; apply amendment_manifest in listed order using RFC 6901 JSON Pointers, requiring each replace target to exist exactly once and prohibiting array-index edits; attach the listed additive Phase 2 sections verbatim; reject duplicate pointers, unknown operations, missing targets, or unlisted changes; serialize sorted keys with compact separators and UTF-8. The frozen wrapper binds the canonical and byte hashes of this complete composite draft, which is the authoritative effective contract.
effective_contract_resolution.unchanged_rule: Every inherited JSON path not listed in amendment_manifest is unchanged. Additive Phase 2 sections may tighten validation, multiplicity, audit, resource, or safety governance but may not alter any unlisted signal, trial, parameter, target, cost, accounting, gate, fold, benchmark, regime, holdout threshold, or prospective threshold.
effective_contract_resolution.conflict_rule: Only an exact listed RFC 6901 pointer may replace frozen v1 text. Additive sections cannot implicitly supersede an unlisted base path. Any conflicting, ambiguous, missing, duplicate, hash-mismatched, or nonmechanically resolvable clause fails closed before implementation.

cross_asset_information_and_fill_synchro.audit_defect: v1 constructed per-asset first fills independently, did not use the maximum availability over every required lookback observation, and rejected unequal fills instead of constructing the earliest valid synchronized vector.
cross_asset_information_and_fill_synchro.corrected_rule: For each trial and synchronized completed signal session s, enumerate every required close, return, volatility, event timestamp, and availability timestamp for both assets. The immutable information cutoff I_s is their maximum. C_s is the earliest exact minute-open timestamp strictly greater than I_s at which retained boundary-prefix rows exist for both BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT. The two rows form one atomic vector. Per-asset candidate fills, mismatched timestamps, forward-filled rows, partial vectors, and a vector derived from less than the full required information set are prohibited.
cross_asset_information_and_fill_synchro.failure_rule: If no exact synchronized vector is available under the causal completeness rules, fail closed through the frozen quarantine/data-integrity precedence. Never choose one asset's fill or scan one asset forward independently.

terminal_vector_selection.audit_defect: v1 selected a session from an assumed session-plus-one-day-plus-one-minute timestamp rather than the actual last canonical C_s inside the boundary.
terminal_vector_selection.corrected_rule: Construct canonical synchronized vectors only from the strict half-open boundary prefix and select the actual final element C_s. Base replaces decision s with cash; delayed replaces the due decision s-1 with cash. In both runs accrue the terminal interval, execute and cost cash once, cancel every other pending target, compute no new decision, and end in exact cash with no pending state. The exact retained MinuteRow identities are used.
terminal_vector_selection.failure_rule: No assumed 00:01 timestamp, reconstructed synthetic identity, later row, or row at/after the boundary may substitute. If exposure cannot be priced and liquidated at the actual terminal vector, fail DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE.

single_execution_clock.audit_defect: v1's pure state machine and reporting pipeline used inconsistent off-by-one pending clocks.
single_execution_clock.corrected_rule: Base and delayed simulations use one clock specification but independent state and therefore may produce different decisions. Base: compute decision s once from completed session s and actual state after C_(s-1); at C_s accrue the prior interval, then execute and cost decision s once. Delayed: at C_s accrue the prior interval, execute and cost immutable decision s-1, then compute decision s from completed session s and the resulting state and queue only for C_(s+1). Within either run a pending target is immutable and cannot be superseded; quarantine safety precedence remains exact.
transition_pseudocode: BASE_NONTERMINAL: assert state is state_after_C_(s-1); decision_s=signal(session_s,state); bind decision_s->C_s; at C_s accrue prior interval; execute decision_s; apply cost; update state; clear due target.

DELAY_NONTERMINAL: at C_s accrue prior interval; if decision_(s-1) is due execute it, apply cost, update state, clear due target; decision_s=signal(session_s,resulting_state); bind decision_s->C_(s+1); do not execute decision_s now.

BASE_TERMINAL: at actual last C_s accrue prior interval; replace decision_s with cash; cancel all other pending; execute/cost cash; compute no new decision; assert exact cash and no pending; terminate.

DELAY_TERMINAL: at actual last C_s accrue prior interval; replace due decision_(s-1) with cash; cancel all other pending; execute/cost cash; compute no decision_s; assert exact cash and no pending; terminate.
Base and delayed state, wealth, decisions, pending targets, and traces are independent; the word immutable refers only to a decision after it is queued inside its own run.
single_execution_clock.identity_rule: The production trace, pure reference, tests, stress path, folds, aggregate run, and auditor all consume the same explicit decision_session_id, due_session_id, due_vector_timestamp, and exact row identities.

dsr_degeneracy_and_phase_2_multiplicity.audit_defect: v1 code failed T=3 although the frozen v1 clause failed only below three, and Phase 1 multiplicity did not include all later observed/attempted evidence.
dsr_degeneracy_and_phase_2_multiplicity.corrected_rule: The primitive v1 formula must accept exactly three finite common endpoints when every other v1 denominator and moment is defined; it must not contain a hidden T>=4 rule. The formal Phase 2 DSR additionally applies the preregistered append-only global trial registry and the causal dependence adjustment below. Failure of the stronger Phase 2 minimum-effective-sample rule returns probability zero; it does not alter signals or returns.
dsr_degeneracy_and_phase_2_multiplicity.economic_effect: Statistical promotion is made stricter; no signal, target, fill, cost, return, threshold, trial, gate, or parameter changes.

strict_boundary_and_quarantine_rules.boundary_index: Before any session, gap, cutoff, vector, state, regime, or accounting construction, create a separate immutable strict-prefix index for each half-open aggregate or fold end. Later rows cannot enter an earlier boundary.
strict_boundary_and_quarantine_rules.duplicates_and_order: Duplicate timestamp keys, nonmonotonic rows, malformed rows, invalid values, and boundary-mismatched indices fail closed rather than overwrite or sort away evidence.
strict_boundary_and_quarantine_rules.exact_lookup: Exact timestamp lookup only; no forward scan may substitute for a named C_s or execution due timestamp.
strict_boundary_and_quarantine_rules.quarantine: All v1 quarantine precedence, segment wealth, forced liquidation, unpriceable-exposure failure, no-bridging, and 150-session recovery clauses remain exact.
strict_boundary_and_quarantine_rules.fold_isolation: Every fold independently starts actual/desired targets, pending state, wealth, PnL, turnover, and entry counts in cash. Only causal pre-fold indicator warmup allowed by v1 may enter, and no later fold row or gap may affect it.
strict_boundary_and_quarantine_rules.terminal_cash: Terminal cash is an ex-ante boundary rule, not a trial or signal change.

multiplicity_registry.observed_slot_extraction_rule: For each status=observed slot, verify the whole artifact canonical hash, resolve exactly its declared JSON Pointer, require a finite JSON number, and divide annualized_sharpe by sqrt(365) to obtain the nonannualized daily Sharpe. No recomputation, fallback path, alternate frequency, rounding, clipping, or value substitution is permitted. Any hash/path/type/finiteness mismatch makes DSR probability zero.
multiplicity_registry.unimputed_slot_rule: Every status=unimputed_no_return slot has no Sharpe value, contributes to N only, is excluded from sigma_SR, and can never be assigned zero, negative infinity, a family proxy, or another attempt's result.
multiplicity_registry.current_run_pre_result_binding: Before formal return calculation, commit seven current names in declared order with the frozen preregistration hash, implementation commit and byte hashes, exact source/data-contract/36-entry allowlist/session-input-manifest hashes, production and independent-oracle code hashes, trace-schema hashes, environment hash, and formal invocation identifier. No result-dependent identity is allowed. After complete atomic serialization append result canonical/byte hashes; they are evidence, never a prerequisite to themselves.
multiplicity_registry.partial_holdout_rule: The one-shot invocation always appends seven named holdout slots. Include only Sharpes that are finite and durably serialized before failure; all remaining holdout slots are named unimputed slots. The result is HOLDOUT_EVALUATION_FAILURE, no candidate is promoted, and no repair, rerun, or alternate extraction is permitted.
multiplicity_registry.partial_attempt_rule: A formal attempt that fails before all seven trial Sharpes are durably produced appends seven named slots, includes only durably produced finite Sharpes in dispersion, leaves missing values unimputed, and cannot produce an economic verdict.
multiplicity_registry.pre_run_repair_rule: A repair before formal trial return computation adds no new current-result slots.

statistical_phase_2_amendments.bootstrap: Preserve the exact v1 primary aggregate valid-return series, Politis-Romano circular stationary bootstrap, expected block length 20, restart probability 0.05, 2,000 resamples, NumPy linear percentiles, and seed 4689472421920140622. A trial-common or comparator panel is not substituted.

deflated_sharpe_ratio.N: Use the exact append-only count for the current stage: 56 for the first completed v2 development run.
deflated_sharpe_ratio.sigma_SR: Sample standard deviation ddof=1 over every and only observed finite registry nonannualized daily Sharpe: 28 prior plus seven current on the first completed run. No-return slots get no pseudo-value.
deflated_sharpe_ratio.observed: Current primary nonannualized daily Sharpe on the exact seven-current-trial common causal endpoint panel.
deflated_sharpe_ratio.autocorrelation: For finite common-panel returns x_0..x_(T-1), require T>=30 and positive centered sum of squares. Compute exact lags 1..28 with denominator sum((x_t-mean)^2), VIF=max(1,1+2*sum((1-k/29)*rho_k)), and T_eff=T/VIF. Any missing/nonfinite lag, invalid VIF, or T_eff<30 yields probability zero.
deflated_sharpe_ratio.probability: Use the v1 skew/nonexcess-kurtosis denominator with sqrt(T_eff-1); any nonpositive/nonfinite denominator or probability yields zero.

statistical_phase_2_amendments.PBO: Use only the seven current v2 trial columns on the exact common causal panel, eight chronological nonempty numpy.array_split blocks, 70 four-block training splits, declared-order tie breaks, and v1 average-rank/logit event. Intentional plus/minus infinity from finite zero-volatility returns remains rankable; NaN, nonfinite raw return, wrong split count, or undefined rank yields PBO one.
statistical_phase_2_amendments.concentration_regime_attribution_and_tra: Exact v1 definitions and degeneracies remain unchanged.
statistical_phase_2_amendments.gate_thresholds: All 19 v1 development gates remain unchanged; stricter multiplicity can only prevent promotion.

production_path_validation_before_formal.unit_and_full_tests: Pass all focused relative-value tests and all repository deterministic tests.
production_path_validation_before_formal.real_data_integration: Run the production loader end to end against only the 36 exact hash-allowlisted development partitions, with no holdout path resolution. Reverify contract, manifest, allowlist, file sizes, SHA-256, parser/runtime, row counts, missing-minute counts, and synchronized session/vector counts.
production_path_validation_before_formal.representative_rows: Use only the frozen deterministic selectors below. Persist private values only where required for audit and publish hashes/counts only; no selector may depend on a return, signal magnitude, gate, profitability, or discrepancy observed after implementation.

deterministic_selectors.per_file: For n>0 retained rows in original file order, select zero-based indices 0, floor((n-1)/2), and n-1; deduplicate identical indices while preserving selector order.
deterministic_selectors.known_gap: For each expected missing minute declared by the frozen contract, select the exact expected missing timestamp plus the nearest retained row immediately before and immediately after it for each asset. Do not search beyond those neighbors.
deterministic_selectors.development_fold_boundaries: For each 2025 fold start/end select the last retained joint vector strictly before the boundary and first retained joint vector at or after it when both remain in the development allowlist. For the 2026-01-01 development endpoint select only the last retained development vector strictly before it; never resolve a suffix row.
deterministic_selectors.availability: Use fixed synthetic fixtures covering equal and unequal full-lookback availability cutoffs and one-asset/asynchronous exact rows; do not choose a real case after inspecting outcomes.
deterministic_selectors.targets: After deterministic trace construction select, for every trial and every aggregate/fold/stress run, the first two target records in chronological trace order if present, regardless of target value or subsequent return.
deterministic_selectors.terminal: Select the exact actual terminal C_s identity in each aggregate/fold base and delayed run plus the immediately preceding canonical vector when present.
deterministic_selectors.duplicates: Every selected identity is recorded once in a stable tuple of selector name, boundary id, trial id, stress id, session id, asset, timestamp, relative path, row group, and row offset.

production_path_validation_before_formal.trace_reconciliation: A separately implemented oracle recomputes required information sets, I_s, synchronized C_s row identities, signals, state transitions, targets, pending dispositions, turnover, costs, interval returns, asset attribution, regime labels, gates, and terminal cash. Before fidelity approval report only identities, counts, hashes, tolerances, and pass/fail, never aggregate performance.
production_path_validation_before_formal.oracle_independence: The oracle may use Python standard library, Decimal, NumPy/SciPy primitives, PyArrow for its own verified-buffer parsing, and frozen JSON contracts, but may not import, call, copy at runtime, monkeypatch, or dispatch to any production relative-value signal, session, cutoff, clock, fill, state, cost, return, attribution, regime, statistic, or gate function. Its module dependency graph and source hash are committed and audited separately.

failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: No economic verdict. Consume one pre-run repair only if code or executable validation evidence must change; rerun every pre-economic check after repair.

failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: No DATA_NO_GO and no economic verdict. Independently reproduce from the exact frozen bytes with a separately verified minimal reader and fidelity-approved contract interpretation.

failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: Terminal reproducible authorized-data no-go; preserve evidence and consume the exact route without calling it unprofitable.

failure_precedence_decision_table.condition: An independent audit attempt ends only by timeout, context exhaustion, or temporary service failure.
failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: No economic or methodology verdict; increment only that stage's audit-attempt counter and retry within the three-attempt cap.

failure_precedence_decision_table.condition: After a complete development run, an audit proves a mechanical implementation defect.
failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: Invalidate and preserve the economic output, append/preserve its seven observed or named missing multiplicity slots, consume one post-run fidelity repair only when code changes are required, complete every pre-economic validation again, obtain fresh fidelity approval, then run the next authorized complete attempt.

failure_precedence_decision_table.condition: All pre-run or post-run repair authority is exhausted but the remaining defect is mechanically repairable without changing the economic hypothesis.
failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: Stop route code work and require human authorization. The exact experiment is administratively terminal under the current budget, but the family is not economically evaluated or consumed and cannot be called profitable, unprofitable, HISTORICAL_NO_GO, or DATA_NO_GO.

failure_precedence_decision_table.condition: The full repair budget is exhausted and the remaining defect cannot be resolved without materially changing the frozen economic hypothesis.
failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: Terminally consume this authorized family under the Phase 2 administrative rule, while explicitly recording that no economic result exists and neither profitability nor unprofitability was established.

failure_precedence_decision_table.condition: A complete contract-faithful fidelity-approved development run and methodology audit fail one or more unchanged gates.
failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: Terminal economic no-go for this experiment; holdout stays sealed.

failure_precedence_decision_table.condition: A complete contract-faithful development run passes all unchanged gates and the methodology audit passes.
failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: Proceed only to the separate pre-holdout robustness audit; this state alone never authorizes holdout resolution.

failure_precedence_decision_table.condition: Evidence is incomplete, partial, unaudited, synthetic, controller-only, trace-only, or reconciliation-only.
failure_precedence_decision_table.effect: Never label the strategy profitable or unprofitable and never promote a candidate.

holdout_and_prospective.pre_approval_entry_points: Every development, production validation, implementation-fidelity audit, development-methodology audit, robustness audit, freeze, and HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED review must use the development-only loader, which rejects 2026 before path resolution.
holdout_and_prospective.post_approval_entry_point: A distinct fixed-latch command exists only after the committed HOLDOUT_OPEN_APPROVED token. It reads the ordered 12 relative paths, byte counts, and SHA-256 values solely from the frozen data contract and committed access record, resolves only those exact paths under the frozen repository root, rejects symlinks/root escape and any mismatch, and performs no discovery.
holdout_and_prospective.latch_arm_point: Exact allowlisted path resolution is permitted only after approval; the first Parquet footer, schema, row-group metadata, or value read atomically changes the latch from APPROVED_UNARMED to ARMED_ONE_SHOT.
holdout_and_prospective.holdout_access: One deterministic invocation only after approval. Any evaluator failure after arming is terminal HOLDOUT_EVALUATION_FAILURE; append seven holdout slots, promote no partial result, and permit no repair, rerun, or reopen.

model_routing.fallback: Only after confirmed quota, rate-limit, throttling, or temporary model-unavailable error; never after a coding, test, data, methodology, or strategy failure.
